    INTEL_64BIT_ARCHS = [:x86_64].freeze
    INTEL_ARCHS       = T.let((INTEL_32BIT_ARCHS + INTEL_64BIT_ARCHS).freeze, T::Array[Symbol])
    PPC_32BIT_ARCHS   = [:ppc, :ppc32, :ppc7400, :ppc7450, :ppc970].freeze
